title: Add explicit progress checkpoint protocol
description: Require inspect/action/observation/progress checkpoints, classify repeated failures and no-progress, and make continuation decisions from progress state. Acceptance: prose/no-op, failed-tool, repeated-failure, and successful-progress scenarios behave deterministically.

logs.msg: Implemented goal_checkpoint protocol and automatic continuation prompts requiring concrete action plus observed evidence; repeated no-progress/blocked checkpoints stop the loop. Covered by domain and integration tests.
